environment.description: Same IoT message handler deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 with a custom AppArmor profile 'iot-msg-handler' loaded in enforce mode. The profile was generated using aa-genprof during a 72-hour training period and then manually hardened. Profile specifies: owner /var/iot/uploads/** rw, deny /var/iot/uploads/../** rw, with additional path-based mediation. The profile uses 'pivot_root' and 'mount' deny rules. Note: the profile uses 'file' rule subset with explicit path enumeration rather than glob-based allow patterns. The container runs with --security-opt=apparmor=iot-msg-handler. Profile hash (sha256): a3f8c2d1e9b74506. Profile audit mode was disabled after validation to reduce log volume.
